notes: P03 task SACMAT-X05_opa_runner (PolicyTrace RQ3): real-binary OPA adapter with a clearly-labelled in-process port. evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/opa_runner.py (OPA_RUNNER_VERSION 1.0.0) implements the task-contract adapter evaluate_opa(module, input) -> Decision: detect_opa() resolves the REAL binary with shutil.which('opa'); when present, run_opa_eval writes the deterministically compiled Rego bundle (compile_rego_module: final-state delegated-consent policy, deny-overrides precedence, package clara.sacmat.delegated_consent, entrypoint data.clara.sacmat.delegated_consent.decision, sorted emission, no clock/randomness) plus a JSON input document to a private temp dir, shells out to `opa eval --format=json` under a subprocess budget, probes the binary's actual `opa version`, and maps real output onto the four-valued oracle (string decisions pass through; true/false -> PERMIT/DENY; OPA undefined -> NOT_APPLICABLE; failures/timeouts/unparseable output -> INDETERMINATE with stable reason codes OPA_EXECUTION_ERROR / OPA_TIMEOUT / OPA_INVALID_OUTPUT). When the binary is ABSENT the runner returns NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL / BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE (never a fabricated verdict, never counted as a completion); ctx.simulate_unavailable_upstream yields the same transparent non-run. HONEST ENGINE STATUS: at proof-emission time the real `opa` binary was NOT installed in this environment (shutil.which('opa') is None), so every executed run in this task's evidence is the labelled in-process port path or the transparent NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL path; NO real OPA execution is claimed. Binary-present behaviour is implemented and conditionally tested (skipif not OPA_PRESENT) so another agent with `opa` on PATH obtains real recorded binary output, version provenance (opa-binary:<version> backend label) and agreement/disagreement adjudication against the port (OPA_PORT_AGREEMENT -> ADMIT / OPA_PORT_DISAGREEMENT -> REJECT, both counted_as_success=True with both backends named in the detail). The faithful in-process XACML-like adapter is explicitly LABELLED as a PORT: evaluate_xacml_port delegates to the existing XacmlPolicyEngine from evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/baselines.py (deny-overrides rule combining over the compiled final policy state, faithful to the XACML 3.0 combining family the MC/DC literature targets) with backend label xacml-port:in-process-port-of-baselines.XacmlPolicyEngine and the detail label 'PORT: ... NOT the upstream OPA binary and NOT an OPA run'; the port is never conflated with a binary verdict. KNOWN_ENCODING_LIMITATIONS declares the labelled portability surface (final-state encoding, (actor, purpose) keys) that RQ3 measures. Injection safety: UNSAFE_POLICY_IDENTIFIER allowlist refuses Rego-unsafe identifiers at compile time (compile happens BEFORE binary detection so malformed units fail closed regardless of binary presence). Malformed cases (missing request, empty/non-list history, unknown event kinds, bad types, non-monotonic times) are first-class INDETERMINATE outcomes with the baselines reason codes; wiring errors (non-mapping case, non-SacmatContext) raise SacmatOpaRunnerError with stable reason codes. Test driver research/venue2027/sacmat/tests/test_opa_runner.py (stdlib + pytest): 33 tests — 30 passed, 3 skipped, 0 failed in this environment (skips are the conditional real-binary tests and a real-OPA-undefined probe, skipped precisely BECAUSE the binary is absent; with `opa` installed they execute the binary and record its real output). Positive: module contract constants, typed OpaVerdict JSON round trip + unknown-verdict refusal, port byte-parity with baselines.XacmlPolicyEngine (PERMIT/DENY/NOT_APPLICABLE), deterministic Rego compilation (byte-identical modules), compiled deny-overrides precedence and header labels, input-document shape, binary-present run recording real output. Adversarial: binary absent -> NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL/BASELINE_UNAVAILABLE with counted_as_success=False, retriable, and NO PERMIT/DENY string in the detail (not a fake success); simulate_unavailable_upstream -> same transparent non-run; failing binary -> INDETERMINATE/OPA_EXECUTION_ERROR; exit-0 unrecognized-output binary -> INDETERMINATE/OPA_INVALID_OUTPUT; injection vectors (tabs, semicolons, spaces, overlong) refused by the runner; quote/backslash/newline/overlong identifiers refused at compile_rego_module/build_opa_input; malformed-case battery (5 reason codes); wiring errors; port-label separation assertions (xacml-port never reported as opa-binary). uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on both touched files; full local evaluation/venue2027/sacmat + research/venue2027/sacmat/tests suite 324 passed, 3 skipped. baseline_parity=NOT_APPLICABLE (this IS the external-engine adapter task; parity of the port against baselines.XacmlPolicyEngine is asserted in-tree). source_sha_after records the base commit 5f97bc36 per the established sibling convention; the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body.
